title: [BUG] : CrewAI Doesn't seem to support VertexAI embedding models.
body:
### Description

I need to use memory feature of CrewAI to make sure that my chatBOT uses the recent interactions to answer the follow up questions. Currently, we are using GCP VertexAI platform. I found following code in the documentation link(https://docs.crewai.com/concepts/memory) to implement the memory but this code is failing because CrewAI doesn't have any 'embedding_functions'. can you point me to the right documentation or help me solve this issue?

from crewai import Crew, Agent, Task, Process

my_crew = Crew(
    agents=[...],
    tasks=[...],
    process=Process.sequential,
    memory=True,
    verbose=True,
    embedder=embedding_functions.GoogleVertexEmbeddingFunction(
        project_id="YOUR_PROJECT_ID",
        region="YOUR_REGION",
        api_key="YOUR_API_KEY",
        model_name="textembedding-gecko"
    )
)


### Steps to Reproduce

Create a crew using following code

from crewai import Crew, Agent, Task, Process

my_crew = Crew(
    agents=[...],
    tasks=[...],
    process=Process.sequential,
    memory=True,
    verbose=True,
    embedder=embedding_functions.GoogleVertexEmbeddingFunction(
        project_id="YOUR_PROJECT_ID",
        region="YOUR_REGION",
        api_key="YOUR_API_KEY",
        model_name="textembedding-gecko"
    )
)

### Expected behavior

Code provided in the documentation should be able to create memory using VertexAI embedding model
